description: Two hierarchical views in one Svelte 5 data grid example. The upper grid flattens a synthetic file tree and indents the name column by depth, with expand and collapse through rowExpandingFeature; the lower grid shows master and detail by mounting a second SvGrid keyed to the selected order row and listing its line items. Both use the MIT @svgrid/grid package.

faq.question: How is the file tree flattened?
faq.answer: A recursive walk turns the nested folders into a flat array with a depth per row; the name column's snippet indents by that depth and the rowExpandingFeature toggles which subtrees are visible. The treeData prop now does this automatically for parent-id data.

faq.question: How does the detail grid follow the selection?
faq.answer: The master grid reports the active row; a $derived filters the line items for that order and a second SvGrid renders them. Selecting another order swaps the detail data in place.

faq.question: Can the detail be inside the master row instead?
faq.answer: Yes. The isDetailRow and renderDetailRow props render a full-width detail row under a master row, which the master/detail nested-grid demo shows.
